verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a dedicated webhooks feature with typed event subscriptions (e.g. `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`), and a payload with screening-result fields that consumers can act on. Every delivery carries a `webhook-id` header for idempotent processing, so a programmatic consumer can register for and receive outbound HTTP callbacks. Missing for 10: a full catalog of subscribable event types, details of how webhooks are registered (API vs UI), signature verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
